ckm-unitary-triangle-closure-relation-91.title: CKM Unitary Triangle
ckm-unitary-triangle-closure-relation-91.interpretation: Describes the unitarity constraint on the quark mixing matrix, where the non-zero area of the triangle in the complex plane represents the amount of CP violation.
ckm-unitary-triangle-closure-relation-91.symmetry_origin: The requirement for probability conservation (unitarity) in flavor-changing transitions.
ckm-unitary-triangle-closure-relation-91.limits_and_boundary: A collapsed triangle (zero area) would imply the absence of CP violation in the Standard Model.

kolmogorov-energy-spectrum-power-law-db8.title: Kolmogorov Energy Spectrum
kolmogorov-energy-spectrum-power-law-db8.interpretation: Describes the distribution of kinetic energy across different spatial scales in a fully developed turbulent flow, where energy is transferred from large eddies to small eddies according to a universal -5/3 power law.
kolmogorov-energy-spectrum-power-law-db8.symmetry_origin: The self-similarity and scale invariance of the inertial subrange in high-Reynolds-number turbulence.
kolmogorov-energy-spectrum-power-law-db8.limits_and_boundary: Valid for wave numbers k within the inertial range, between the large-scale forcing and the small-scale viscous dissipation.

longitudinal-polarization-identity-1-434.title: Longitudinal Polarization Vector of Massive Vector Bosons
longitudinal-polarization-identity-1-434.interpretation: \( m \) is the boson mass, \( \mathbf{k} \) is the spatial momentum vector, and \( \omega \) is the energy/frequency.
longitudinal-polarization-identity-1-434.symmetry_origin: Poincaré covariance and Higgs mechanism in electroweak gauge theory.
longitudinal-polarization-identity-1-434.limits_and_boundary: In the high-energy limit \( \omega \gg m \), the polarization vector behaves as \( \epsilon_L^\mu \approx k^\mu / m \), which leads to Goldstone boson equivalence.

m.name: Boson Mass
m.description: The rest mass of the massive vector boson.

\\mathbf{k}.name: Boson Momentum Vector
\\mathbf{k}.description: The spatial momentum vector of the boson.

longitudinal-polarization-identity-1-434.conceptual_definition: This equation defines the longitudinal polarization four-vector \( \epsilon_L^\mu(k) \) for a massive vector boson (like the \( W \) or \( Z \) boson) of mass \( m \), momentum \( k \), and frequency \( \omega \) moving along the z-axis, satisfying the orthogonality condition.
longitudinal-polarization-identity-1-434.intuitive_summary: Massive spin-1 particles possess a third polarization state pointing along their direction of motion, whose amplitude scales inversely with their mass at high energies.

logical-basis-ontology-identity-1-ce0a3e.title: Quantum Logic Lattice Non-Distributivity Relation
logical-basis-ontology-identity-1-ce0a3e.interpretation: \( P, Q, R \) are propositions (represented as projection operators on a Hilbert space), \( \land \) is the meet (logical AND), and \( \lor \) is the join (logical OR).
logical-basis-ontology-identity-1-ce0a3e.symmetry_origin: Non-commutativity of projection operators in quantum mechanics.
logical-basis-ontology-identity-1-ce0a3e.limits_and_boundary: If all projection operators commute, the distributivity equality holds, recovering classical Boolean logic.
logical-basis-ontology-identity-1-ce0a3e.conceptual_definition: In quantum logic (developed by Birkhoff and von Neumann), propositions form an orthomodular lattice where the distributive law of classical logic fails, replaced by this weaker modular/orthomodular inequality.
logical-basis-ontology-identity-1-ce0a3e.intuitive_summary: In the quantum world, saying 'P is true AND (either Q or R is true)' does not mean the same thing as 'either (P and Q) or (P and R) is true', because measuring one property changes the system's state.

navier-stokes-momentum-fluids-27e5bf4d.title: Navier-Stokes Momentum Equation (Fluid Dynamics and Nonlinear Systems)
navier-stokes-momentum-fluids-27e5bf4d.interpretation: Serves as the fundamental momentum conservation equation for a viscous Newtonian fluid, coupling local acceleration, non-linear advection, pressure gradients, and viscous shear dissipation.
navier-stokes-momentum-fluids-27e5bf4d.symmetry_origin: Galilean invariance and translation symmetry of the continuous fluid parcel.
navier-stokes-momentum-fluids-27e5bf4d.limits_and_boundary: Contracts to the inviscid Euler equations as viscosity approaches zero, or to linear Stokes flow in the limit of small Reynolds numbers.
